title: cacalia obovata
intro: Cacalia obovata, commonly known as Yellowhead or Yellow-headed Cacalia, is a perennial plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis, digestive issues, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Cacalia obovata are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit cytotoxic effects against cancer cells. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
